items.title: Partnership with Nvidia? Two high-flying A-share stocks respond urgently: not true

On the evening of September 13, Jin'an Guoji announced that the circulating information is untrue, that the company has had no contact with Nvidia or Huawei and has no form of business cooperation with them
items.summary_zh: A股市场上两只涨幅最大的股票同时发布澄清公告。9月13日晚间，金安国纪公告称，市场流传信息不属实，公司未与英伟达、华为有过任何接触，也不存在任何形式的业务合作
